verdict.rationale: Missive documents a public REST API at public.missiveapp.com/v1 with an endpoint reference covering conversations, drafts, posts, contacts, labels and analytics, plus published rate limits with 429/Retry-After semantics, webhooks, and Markdown/llms.txt docs that agents can read. API and MCP server access are listed as a plan feature, and drafts can be created through the API and MCP server, so an AI-native user can drive the product programmatically. Missing for 10: no OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probe paths returned 404), no try-it runner, no formal versioning/deprecation policy, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
